text:
sam: seeing a bunch of ContainerCreating delays in us-west3 during the 09:10 attach wave. pods stuck ~20-40s. nvme util looks pegged. suspect scrub overlap.

tia: can you paste node snippets?

sam: small tail: 
```
# iostat -x 1 2
Device    r/s    w/s  rkB/s  wkB/s  avgqu-sz  await  %util
nvme0n1  900.0 2400.0  46000 320000    2.8     9.8   97.9
```
```
[ 2222.123] scrubber: starting async scrub on nvme0n1
[ 2222.300] nvme0n1: queue depth saturated, throttling
[ 2222.501] kubelet: attach timeout waiting for ephemeral disk
```

ben: yep scrub starts exactly when autoscaler fires. short-term: pause scrub on a small cohort, lower scrub ioprio, add ephemeral-quiet label so scheduler avoids scrub-heavy nodes during attaches.

sre-bot: [action] cohort us-west3-c-cohort-2 labeled infra.janitor.pause=true at 1728702500

tia: good. collect `nvme smart-log` from 3 hosts and open ticket if util remains >95% after mitigation. also track attach_success_rate metric.

sam: applied pause and lowered scrub ioprio. attach success jumped 70% -> 97% in 3m. leaving monitoring for 30m; filing TKT-4607 with logs.

ben: followups: RFC to make scrub-scheduler back off on forecasted attach waves and a cost calc for extending scrub windows.

sre-bot: [info] TKT-4607 created: "attach delays correlated with scrub IO during autoscaler attach wave"
